about: oguz-atolye U-19 (R04 §6): four mutation families, one mutant each, for every check the code offers (every name registered in pocad.core and pocad.measure, and every STEP round-trip result). Each check PASSes on its base fixture. Each mutant is KILLED (the gate FAILs), INCONCLUSIVE (the check cannot measure it, which is never a pass), or SURVIVED, and a survivor names its blind spot and the check that covers it. A check no family kills names its known-bad fixture. The limits in the gates are test limits that the base passes, not GATES values (D-009). tests/test_mutations.py proves every row.

families.resize: one dimension of the base changed
families.relocate: one feature, or the part, moved
families.remove: one feature or face taken away
families.degrade: the geometry re-exported through build123d export_step (AP214) and read back, or the STL meshed at 0.5 mm instead of 0.01 mm
